C1168.title: API Enumeration Attack Detection Guide Project
C1168.summary: On February 25, 2026, mukul975 published an API enumeration attack detection guide on GitHub. The document identifies sequential object-identifier access, 401 and 403 authorization failures, and abnormal request rates as monitoring signals, and provides examples for Splunk, Elastic SIEM, and a custom detector. It is a detection-method resource rather than a record of a specific security incident.

references.title: Detecting API Enumeration Attacks - Initial GitHub Revision
